Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Certification request — sanitize prompts/outputs/logs for project payment-intel

Hi Sofia,

Per our security and data residency commitments, FinRidge needs Redwood to perform a final sanitation and provide a signed certification for all customer-provided prompts, generated outputs, and runtime logs tied to our account (FinRidge acct: FR-99821), project tag: payment-intel. Scope: Jan 1, 2025 through Jun 30, 2027. We need:
- Confirmation that prompt inputs and generated outputs were permanently deleted from active KV caches and prompt logs.
- Confirmation that runtime logs and traces (request-level) for the above timeframe were expunged, or details on what was retained and why.
- A signed PDF certificate and a checklist of deleted artifacts plus an audit log snapshot for our records.

Target deadline: EOD Sep 16, 2027 if possible. This is for a regulatory evidence submission next week.

Thanks — let me know what you need from our side.

Regards,
Dylan Whitman
Head of Security Operations
FinRidge

Subject: Re: Certification request — sanitize prompts/outputs/logs for project payment-intel

Dylan — thanks for the clear scope. We can do this and certify the purge. Next steps I propose:
1) I will open an internal purge ticket (RDW-2027-8762) and loop in Ops and Security (cc'd).
2) Ops will execute the deletion across: prompt-input logs, generated-response artifacts, KV cache prefixes tagged payment-intel, and request-level traces for the specified date range.
3) Security will produce an audit snapshot and signed certificate (PDF).
4) I will deliver the certificate, the checklist of deleted artifact types, and the audit snapshot link by EOD Sep 16.

Can you confirm the scope excludes backups older than 180 days (we'll treat backups separately unless you request a longer retention purge)? Also confirm whether Legal needs a separate DocuSign-signed statement.

Ticket will include a downloadable audit snapshot and the purge manifest.

Sofia Ivanova

Subject: ACTION: RDW-2027-8762 — FinRidge payment-intel purge (Jan 2025 - Jun 2027)

Team — tagging for ops. Dylan at FinRidge requested full sanitization of prompts/outputs and request logs for project tag payment-intel between 2025-01-01 and 2027-06-30. Deliverables:
- Execute permanent deletion (irreversible) for: prompt_input.logs (S3 paths with tag payment-intel), generated_output artifacts, runtime request traces, and any derived model derivatives tied to that tag/tenant.
- Invalidate and remove KV cache prefixes used by payment-intel (both active GPU cache and long-lived caching layers).
- Produce a signed certificate PDF and a manifest listing deleted files and object IDs.
- Create an audit snapshot (RDW-2027-8762-audit-log-snapshot.txt) showing the deletion events (timestamps + operator IDs) and upload to the evidence S3 path.
- Note: FinRidge explicitly excluded backups older than 180 days unless they confirm otherwise.

Please confirm ETA and any rollback constraints. Mark actions done in the ticket and paste the purge command outputs into the audit snapshot. We need to ship to the customer by EOD 2027-09-16.

Thanks,
Sofia
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: ACTION: RDW-2027-8762 — FinRidge payment-intel purge (Jan 2025 - Jun 2027)

Sofia / team — we completed the purge run this morning. Summary of actions performed (RDW-2027-8762):
- Deleted: S3 objects with prefix s3://redwood-prod/finridge/payment-intel/prompt-inputs/ (2025-01-01 to 2027-06-30) — 12,342 objects removed.
- Deleted: generated_responses/ payment-intel — 9,710 objects removed.
- Cleared: KV cache prefixes (gpu-kv/payment-intel/*) — cache invalidation and explicit eviction performed.
- Traces: request-level traces for the date range were purged from hot storage. We retained aggregated telemetry metrics (counts/timings) that do not contain request payloads per our standard telemetry policy.

Attached: RDW-2027-8762-purge-ticket.json (ticket manifest), RDW-2027-8762-audit-log-snapshot.txt (sequential deletion events), and a draft purge certificate for signatures. Operator: marissa_cole.

Notes: backups in Glacier >180 days were not touched; if FinRidge wants third-party backup purges we'll need an explicit addendum.

Marissa Cole
Platform Operations Lead — Redwood Inference
